table inet rout_compat_fixture {
	comment "Rout traffic v1"
	counter up {
		packets 0 bytes 123
	}

	counter down {
		packets 0 bytes 456
	}

	quota budget {
		over 1000000 bytes used 579 bytes
	}

	set alive {
		type inet_service
		timeout 15s
	}

	chain up_gate {
		udp dport @alive goto up_allow
		drop
	}

	chain up_allow {
		quota name "budget" drop
		counter name "up" return
	}

	chain down_gate {
		udp sport @alive goto down_allow
		drop
	}

	chain down_allow {
		quota name "budget" drop
		counter name "down" return
	}

	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority 300; policy accept;
		ip daddr 127.0.0.1 udp dport 49123 jump up_gate
	}

	chain output {
		type filter hook output priority 300; policy accept;
		ip saddr 127.0.0.1 udp sport 49123 jump down_gate
	}
}
